summary.headline: Astrological Aspects and Transfer Signs
summary.text: Explanation of astrological transfer, retrograde motion, and ephemeris notation for planets, lunar nodes, apogees, fixed stars, and shatirat. It defines symbols and abbreviations for conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition, impression, combustion, embodiment, aspect, transfer, nocturnal and diurnal conditions, and explains the recording order for aspects and shatirat.
